abstract: Gallup's Q4 2025 workplace AI adoption survey reveals that nearly half of US workers (46%) now use AI tools at work, representing a 13 percentage point increase from the first quarter of 2025. The rapid adoption is primarily concentrated among white-collar professional and technical workers, indicating significant workplace integration of AI technologies within nine months.
keyFindings: 46% of US workers reported using AI tools at work in Q4 2025, compared to 33% in Q1 2025, representing a 13 percentage point increase over nine months.
AI adoption is concentrated in white-collar professional and technical roles rather than distributed evenly across occupational categories.
The rapid acceleration in AI tool adoption demonstrates widespread workplace integration within a single year.
methodology: Gallup survey of US workers measuring AI tool adoption across quarters Q1 2025 and Q4 2025. Specific sample size, sampling methodology, and detailed demographic breakdown not provided in excerpt.
qualifiers: Limited excerpt provided; full survey details including sample size, margin of error, specific occupational breakdowns, and regional variations not available in source text.
